purpose: Exact-ID, Wiki-backed proposals for remaining generic CLEANUP/cleanup CURRENCY, RUNE, or TELEPORT candidates. Research only; requires independent application review.

proposals.name: Blighted entangle sack
proposals.quote: A '''blighted entangle sack''' is an item that allows players to cast [[Entangle]], [[Snare]], or [[Bind]] without needing the [[runes]] for it. However, it can only be used inside the [[Wilderness]], [[Ferox Enclave]], [[Mage Arena bank]], [[PvP world]]s, [[Castle Wars]], [[Clan Wars]], and [[Soul Wars]], while on the [[standard spellbook]]. It is consumed upon cast, regardless of a [[successful hit]].
proposals.rationale: The exact sack replaces the runes needed to cast Entangle, Snare, or Bind, is restricted to named PvP/minigame locations, and is consumed per cast.

proposals.name: Blighted vengeance sack
proposals.quote: A '''blighted vengeance sack''' is an item that allows players to cast [[Vengeance]] or [[Vengeance Other]] without needing the [[runes]] for it. However, it can only be used inside the [[Wilderness]], [[Ferox Enclave]], [[Mage Arena bank]], [[PvP world]]s, [[Castle Wars]], [[Clan Wars]], and [[Soul Wars]], while on the [[Lunar spellbook]]. It is consumed upon use.
proposals.rationale: The exact sack replaces the runes needed for Vengeance or Vengeance Other, is restricted to named PvP/minigame locations, and is consumed on use.

proposals.name: Blighted surge sack
proposals.quote: A '''blighted surge sack''' is an item purchased from the [[Emir's Arena]] reward shop. It allows players to cast any [[surge spells]] or [[wave spells]] without needing the [[runes]] for it. However, it can only be used inside the [[Wilderness]], [[Ferox Enclave]], [[Mage Arena bank]], [[PvP world]]s, [[Castle Wars]], [[Clan Wars]], and [[Soul Wars]], while on the [[standard spellbook]].
proposals.rationale: The exact sack replaces runes for Surge/Wave spells, is restricted to named PvP/minigame locations, and belongs with spell supplies; its purchase source does not make it currency.

proposals.name: Bottle of slug's mind balm
proposals.quote: Drinking the bottle grants 75 Sailing experience and will cause the player to black out, capsizing their boat and leaving them on the shore near [[Witchaven Dungeon]], as well as [[Temporary skill drain|draining]] [[Strength]] and [[Magic]] levels by 20% of their current level. Players who are [[teleblocked]] will not be teleported to shore.
proposals.rationale: Drinking directly transports the player to shore near Witchaven Dungeon, but also capsizes the boat and drains Strength and Magic; classify by its movement function while preserving that drawback.

proposals.name: Bottle of the way home
proposals.quote: Drinking the bottle grants 75 Sailing experience, and will teleport players to the [[Portal (Player-owned house)|house portal]] leading to their [[player-owned house]], with their boat docking at [[Port Sarim]] and [[courier task]] cargo being lost. If a player-owned house has not yet been purchased, players are instead teleported to the [[Rimmington]] house portal.
proposals.rationale: Drinking directly teleports the player to the house portal or Rimmington house portal; it also docks the boat at Port Sarim and loses courier cargo.

proposals.name: Bottle of exile's welcome
proposals.quote: Drinking the bottle grants 75 Sailing experience, and will teleport the player to one of five teleport locations from the [[lunar spellbook]]: [[Catherby]], [[Waterbirth Island]], [[Port Khazard]], [[Barbarian Outpost]], or the [[Fishing Guild]]; each destination is equally likely.
proposals.rationale: Drinking directly teleports the player to one of five Lunar spellbook locations; the same article describes boat docking/cargo consequences.

proposals.name: Bottle of winter sun
proposals.quote: Drinking the bottle requires 78 Sailing, grants 75 Sailing experience, and teleports players to the top of a cliff west of [[Pollnivneach]]. The player's [[boat]] will be docked at the [[Ruins of Unkah]] if it has the necessary facilities to withstand [[Stormy seas]], or [[Port Sarim]] if it does not. [[Courier task]] cargo in the hold will be destroyed. An [[Clue scroll (elite) - 05.24S 26.56E|elite coordinate clue]] requires players to dig at the teleport location, which may be useful as a one-time teleport.
proposals.rationale: Drinking at 78 Sailing directly teleports the player west of Pollnivneach; the article also states courier cargo in the boat hold is destroyed.
